name: Artemidorus the Grammarian
bio: Artemidorus the Grammarian is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 3rd century BC. Paton's index describes him as a grammarian.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 205).

poems.title: Book IX, 205
poems.author: Artemidorus the Grammarian
poems.text: The bucolic poems were once scattered, but are now all in one fold, in one flock.
